reason: Accepted in the 2026-07-16 Phase-4 needs_review triage batch (HANDOFF session 9). Fresh full harvest reproduced the committed CSVs exactly; this program parsed with confidence >= 0.75, zero error-severity issues, and only placeholder-row / phantom-id warnings (the app renders placeholder rows as advisory slots). Guard applied: no oversized (>30 cr) secondary required_list tables (the language-page shape where elective lists parse as required was excluded). Sample of 7 batch programs eyeballed against cached pages before acceptance. [Ported from UF Planner, whose reviewer checked the 2025-2026 page. 2026-10-12: this parse of the 2026-2027 page lists exactly the requirement courses that reviewer accepted, so the review carries over.] [2026-10-12, https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/colleges-schools/UGAGL/PLB_UMN/: the parser now splits 'Electives 9' out of the 'Plant breeding - select one: 3' chooser (it used to be absorbed as a placeholder, so the 9 elective credits were never required). Footnote 1 on AGR 4320 / HOS 4241C: 'One of these courses if not taken for plant breeding requirement' -> exclusive set over the two groups. Footnote 2 on FOR 4934, PLP 3002C, PLP 4600: 'Only one of these courses can be counted towards the minor' -> count rule (they are the pool's only FOR/PLP courses).]
